name: DuckDB CQRS Phase 4 - Serving Reads And Job Migration
description: Move production review reads and bulk/search/export/PDF behavior behind serving readers and durable jobs, with route-specific parity gates and no raw fallback paths.

userStories.title: Build reviewServingReader core
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a reviewServingReader core so migrated routes can read through manifests, admission, cursors, and serving SQL without raw fallback decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `src/server/reviewServing/reviewServingReader.ts` with manifest lookup, contract lookup, admission, cursor/filter signature validation, SQL builder usage, SQL-shape assertion, and diagnostics plumbing.
Reader execution rejects missing project/snapshot identity, unsupported contract keys, stale snapshots without explicit stale allowance, and missing required component state before DuckDB execution.
Reader code does not call OLAP wrappers, raw fallback helpers, route-local cursor parsers, or `selected_scoped_article_import` builders.
Targeted reader tests cover ready, stale, indexing, unavailable, failed, candidate, retired, and missing-snapshot diagnostics without raw fallback.
bun test src/server/reviewServing passes
bun test src/services/olap/duckdbOlap.test.ts passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Add reader count and search states
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the reader to handle count and search state explicitly so count and search routes can return ready, stale, unavailable, or async responses without foreground raw scans.
acceptanceCriteria: Reader count lookups require supported named count keys, filter keys, matching snapshot state, and bounded result caps.
Reader search handling distinguishes token/prefix ready reads from unsupported substring search and returns explicit unavailable or async state for substring search.
Tests prove searched counts preserve supported scope or return explicit unavailable/async state instead of scanning raw or large serving rows.
Tests prove foreground admission rejects mismatched search modes before DuckDB execution.
bun test src/server/reviewServing passes
bun test src/services/olap/duckdbOlap.test.ts passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Add reader article-set hydration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want bounded article-set hydration in the reader so filtered list and detail routes can hydrate rows and judgment payloads without N+1 lookups.
acceptanceCriteria: Reader supports article-set row hydration from serving tables with stable list-mode and article-ID tie-break ordering.
Reader supports article-set LLM, human, and both-list judgment payload hydration through `mart.review_article_judgment_detail_serving_v4` contracts.
Hydration requests enforce max page size, max response bytes, max hydrated payload bytes, and per-request article ID caps.
Tests prove filtered list hydration uses posting/search selection plus article-set row and payload hydration with no N+1 single-article lookup path.
bun test src/server/reviewServing passes
bun test src/services/olap/duckdbOlap.test.ts passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Create route parity runner
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a route-specific parity runner so each route migration is blocked on semantic, budget, freshness, cursor, and SQL-shape mismatches.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a parity runner/check module that compares `reviewServingReader` output against semantic fixtures and safe-size current behavior before a route is mounted.
Parity checks cover row payload semantics, named count states, freshness states, cursor behavior, SQL shape, latency budgets, result bytes, and forbidden foreground DuckDB work.
Tests prove parity validation blocks route migration on semantic fixture, invariant, sampled parity, cursor, freshness-state, SQL-shape, latency, or response-size mismatches.
Existing OLAP forwarding tests are not treated as passing Phase 4 serving parity by themselves.
bun test src/server/reviewServing passes
bun test src/services/olap/duckdbOlap.test.ts passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Build review search service
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a reviewSearchService so ready token/prefix search and async/unavailable substring behavior are enforced at the API boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `src/server/reviewServing/reviewSearchService.ts` that serves ready token/prefix search from `review.search.tokenPrefix` contracts.
Substring search returns unavailable/search-indexing state or creates bounded async search work; it never runs as a synchronous full-table scan.
Search requests bind search mode, search text, project identity, snapshot identity, and projection identity before DuckDB work.
Targeted tests prove token/prefix search behavior and async/unavailable substring behavior.
bun test src/server/reviewServing passes
bun test src/services/olap/duckdbOlap.test.ts passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Create bulk operation job service
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a durable reviewBulkOperationService so select-all, add-to-project, PDF, and export criteria are persisted instead of materializing all matching IDs in foreground requests.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `src/server/reviewServing/reviewBulkOperationService.ts` backed by `app.review_bulk_operation_job` and existing read contracts.

Job creation persists job kind, criteria, filter signature, search mode/text when relevant, projection identity, snapshot pin or declared latest-snapshot semantics, cancellation state, retry state, and progress metadata.
Select-all, add-to-project-by-filter, PDF-by-filter/project, and export jobs do not return all matching article IDs from foreground requests.
Explicit-ID add-to-project and PDF bulk paths enforce article-ID-only caps or are explicitly classified outside project-scoped review-serving selection semantics.

bun test src/services/olap/duckdbOlap.test.ts passes

userStories.title: Create bulk operation worker
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a reviewBulkOperationWorker so durable review jobs execute in bounded keyset batches with retry, cancellation, resume, and snapshot safety.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `src/server/workers/reviewBulkOperationWorker.ts` that claims durable job work and executes bounded keyset batches.
Worker supports cancellation, retry, resume, progress updates, terminal failure, and terminal completion without process-local memory state.
Repeatable durable jobs pin serving snapshots and cleanup skips pinned base, patch, payload, count, and search state.
Job lookup tests prove `/api/articles/pdf-fetch-jobs/:jobId`-style reads use job-table cursor fields instead of in-memory process-local state.

userStories.title: Migrate LLM list and count routes
userStories.description: As a user, I want LLM review list and count routes served by the serving reader so the normal LLM review flow avoids raw OLAP fallbacks and large-offset pagination.
acceptanceCriteria: Migrate `projectsRoutesGetArticlesReviews.ts` and `projectsRoutesGetArticlesReviewsCount.ts` to `reviewServingReader` without raw fallback logic.

Routes preserve current row metadata, article timestamps or capped companion hydration, prompt-level LLM judgment arrays, prompt badges, duplicate/conflict/article-created-date/prompt/search filter scope, and count states.
Route inventory entries become `mounted: true` only when the full product response shape is covered; partial helper contracts remain unmounted.
Route tests prove no raw fallback, no `selected_scoped_article_import`, no raw project-wide scans, no large ID arrays, no `OFFSET`, and no JSON extraction/sorts.
Browser review-flow verification covers ready, stale, indexing, and unavailable freshness states for this migrated flow.

userStories.title: Migrate review filter and facet routes
userStories.description: As a user, I want review and human filter routes served by facet and filter-option contracts so filter responses are complete and not derived from posting rows alone.

userStories.title: Migrate detail and article hydration routes
